name: As sombras despertam — Terminal 08
principles: Architecture must explain each walkable surface; no arbitrary floating blocks.
Ground route remains readable; upper paths and canal paths reconnect.
Each new challenge is shown safely before combining it with combat.
Create silhouette, elevation and pacing changes; do not tile one facade throughout.

sectors.name: Cais das Sombras
sectors.landmark: dock crane and warm cargo warehouse
routes: short wooden pier with return stairs
sectors.encounters: one dormant drone after a safe jumping section
sectors.challenge: short jumps over water, generous platforms
sectors.art: wharf, pier, crane, cargo doors, crates, dock stairs

sectors.name: Rua dos Lampiões
sectors.role: introduce patrol and first shadow fragment
sectors.landmark: corner shop and Gothic courtyard arch
sectors.encounters: patrol drone then one announced shot in clear space
sectors.challenge: choose street safety or upper shortcut
sectors.art: storefront, residential balcony, passage arch, stairs, fountain, courtyard gate

sectors.name: Telhados do Relógio
sectors.role: vertical traversal and first major vista
sectors.encounters: one hovering drone between wide landings
sectors.challenge: height variation and controlled jumps without mandatory blind leaps
sectors.art: slate roof, terrace, chimneys, fire escape, clocktower, plank connector

sectors.name: Ponte dos Ecos
sectors.role: combine jumping and evasion; second fragment
routes: short secret drainage branch returning to bridge
sectors.encounters: alternating drone positions, no unavoidable crossfire
sectors.challenge: broken bridge segment followed by a safe landing
sectors.art: stone arch, steel span, broken end, lock gears, drain, railings

sectors.name: Pátio das Máquinas
sectors.role: industrial traversal climax and final fragment
sectors.landmark: factory skylights and a riveted lift gantry
routes: optional lift to the generator platform
sectors.encounters: two drones in separated readable arenas
sectors.challenge: moving lift introduced above safe flooring, then a controlled jump
sectors.art: factory roof, boiler, catwalk, lift, exhaust pipes, factory wall

sectors.name: Terminal 08
sectors.landmark: reinforced terminal gate and circular control mechanism
routes: wide flat arena with visible exits
sectors.encounters: large round-eye Vigia; fixed-direction charge with anticipation and recovery
sectors.challenge: boss arena uses learned dash timing; no surprise floor gaps
sectors.art: terminal gate, control mechanism, reactor, tunnel, arena wall, shadow alcove

readability.checkpoints: blue infinity mark at safe level ground
readability.decorations: never imply a required mechanic that is not implemented
readability.mandatory_fragments: Visible from the principal route; hidden branches provide optional rewards, never an unexplained progression lock.

implementation_followup: convert architectural chunks into measured collision surfaces
test jumps, fallbacks and reconnecting paths
place drones after routes are traversable
test whole route, then publish HTML

reference_art.note: The six numbered panels are a folded overview of one long level, not a literal shared collision grid.
